| 4. Decision
| - Result checking VP bending after cutting Laser
| + Mold press 90 Kgf/cm², Normal vulcanizing agent, 2nd cure 120⁰ C/ 150⁰ C/1hr: All mold VP #4, #7, #8 have rate bending is high

| + Mold press 120 Kgf/cm², normal vulcanizing agent , 2nd cure 120⁰ C/ 150⁰ C/1hr: VP #4, #8 rate bending is high, VP mold #7 ( 2nd cure 120⁰ C) have rate bending is high, VP #7 (2nd cure 150⁰ C) is more good
| - Result checking function
| + VP #4, #8 of all type test have NG rate of function is higher normal VP
| + VP #7 of some type test have NG rate of function is same normal
| => Can not use VP # 4, #8, need to more improve from supplier
